in_marathi.name: Mahender
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Powerful in mind and soul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahender हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahender is derived from the Sanskrit words 'maha' meaning great and 'indra' meaning lord of mind. This name signifies being powerful, wise, and having a strong mind and soul.
